text:
clare: Quick sync: launch posts + benchmark narratives + webinar are go. Need a tiny SEO playbook today: keyword targets per post, event schema for webinar, internal link map, and redirects for legacy CTAs.
tariq: I can own keywords and meta titles. Can we reuse the product PR seed list? Link: https://drive.redwood/launch/pr-notes
ana: I'll draft the webinar Event JSON-LD and ensure structured data for product pages. Example to reuse:
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Scaling Inference: Boardroom Series","startDate":"2025-05-14T17:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.com/webinar/scaling-inference","organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}
```
sam: I'll map internal anchors: 4 blog posts -> webinar landing and two pillar docs. Use mixed anchors (CTA short + descriptive longtail).
clare: Redirect plan: /signup-legacy -> /webinar/scaling?utm_source=legacy (302 for 7 days, then 301) and squash /old-docs/* -> /docs/learn-inference (avoid chains >1). Also ensure HSTS preserved.
tariq: Keyword plan: 5 primary keywords + 8 longtails per post. Will run clustering and share CSV.
nana: Also found a duplicate canonical on /blog/launch-digest — will fix to point to canonical /blog/launch.
seo-bot: scan-results: 3 redirect chains, 9 pages missing schema, 2 pages with duplicate canonicals. Report: /scans/1761119999-scan.csv
clare: Priority: add Event schema to webinar (P0), fix duplicate canonicals (P0), staged redirect rules (P1), internal link matrix (P1).
sam: For lead routing: if HubSpot times out, post to /leads/fallback-queue and include utm_campaign + utm_content in payload.
tariq: Also recommend robots-meta on staging mirror: <meta name="robots" content="noindex,nofollow"> to prevent early indexing.
clare: Nice. Drop :white_check_mark: when done and I'll merge into launch checklist.
tariq: ✅
sam: ✅ (matrix uploaded)
nana: ✅
seo-bot: redirect rules applied to staging at 1761119985
clare: Thanks all 1 compiling and prepping briefing for comms team :sparkles:
